Statement: System shall support secure login logout session expiration and server-side revocation.
Acceptance_Criteria: Valid credentials generate opaque session token; logout revokes session; expired tokens rejected with HTTP 401.

Statement: System shall enforce role-based access control with administrative role assignment and account status management.
Acceptance_Criteria: Only ADMIN role can assign roles; non-admin attempts yield 403; privilege escalations audited.

Statement: System shall maintain product catalog with unique SKU name active status and positive weight bounds.
Acceptance_Criteria: Duplicate SKUs and negative/zero weights rejected with 422 Unprocessable Entity.

Statement: System shall maintain discrete warehouse grid locations with valid coordinates types and blocked obstacles.
Acceptance_Criteria: Unique coordinate pairs per warehouse; out-of-bounds or overlapping obstacle definitions rejected.

Statement: System shall track inventory balances per product and location with available and reserved quantities.
Acceptance_Criteria: Available stock = on_hand - reserved; on_hand and reserved strictly >= 0; conservation invariant holds.

Statement: System shall register automated robots with unique serial capacity battery initial position and device tokens.
Acceptance_Criteria: Robot registered with hashed device token; disabled robots excluded from assignment.

Statement: System shall accept customer orders with positive item quantities and request idempotency keys.
Acceptance_Criteria: Replay with identical idempotency key returns original order without duplicate stock reservation.

Statement: System shall reserve stock for all order items atomically or fail completely without partial allocation.
Acceptance_Criteria: Concurrent orders competing for last stock allocate to exactly one order; second receives 409 Conflict.

Statement: System shall create fulfillment tasks for reserved items and assign them to eligible idle robots.
Acceptance_Criteria: Only OPERATOR/MANAGER can assign tasks; robot must be IDLE with fresh heartbeat and valid capacity.

Statement: System shall execute pickup movement and packing drop sequentially updating physical ledger.
Acceptance_Criteria: Stock decrements at source and increments at packing area only upon verified drop confirmation.

Statement: System shall track real-time robot heartbeat battery status position and flag stale robots.
Acceptance_Criteria: Robot without heartbeat for >30s transitions to OFFLINE; barred from new task dispatch.

Statement: System shall prevent robot collision duplicate assignment and conflicting transit commands.
Acceptance_Criteria: Two robots cannot occupy the same grid cell; swap maneuvers rejected; one active task per robot.

Statement: System shall allow operational pause order cancellation before pickup and controlled fault recovery.
Acceptance_Criteria: Paused warehouse blocks all movement; pre-pick cancel releases reserved stock; post-pick holds for review.

Statement: System shall present authenticated fulfillment results delivery timestamps and exception reports.
Acceptance_Criteria: Customer can only view own order results (IDOR prevention); Manager views global warehouse status.

Statement: System shall maintain an append-only attributable security audit log of all sensitive events.
Acceptance_Criteria: Logins role updates stock adjustments task dispatches and denials recorded with UTC timestamp and actor ID.

Statement: System shall expose live/ready health checks and basic operational telemetry metrics.
Acceptance_Criteria: Endpoints /health/live and /health/ready return 200 OK; metrics track failures and active robots.

Statement: System shall provide filtered search and visual alerts for low inventory thresholds.
Acceptance_Criteria: Filtered queries return correct subset within 200ms; low stock warning displayed when stock < threshold.

Statement: System shall support CSV inventory export and battery-optimized robot path selection.
Acceptance_Criteria: Export produces valid RFC-4180 CSV without revealing device secrets; battery > 20% prioritized.

Statement: Read API response latency shall be under 500 ms at p95 under standard laboratory load.
Acceptance_Criteria: Verified via automated HTTP load benchmarking measuring p95 response time.

Statement: Database shall enforce serializable or read-committed row-level locks preventing overselling.
Acceptance_Criteria: Multi-threaded concurrency tests verify 0 overselling under simultaneous requests.

Statement: System shall safely recover task state and maintain ledger consistency following worker crash.
Acceptance_Criteria: Terminating worker mid-task does not duplicate movements or orphan reserved inventory.

Statement: Web user interfaces shall provide clear keyboard navigation labels and readable contrast.
Acceptance_Criteria: Complies with WCAG 2.1 AA contrast standards and explicit form field labeling.

Statement: System setup shall be 100% reproducible using versioned database migrations and lockfiles.
Acceptance_Criteria: Fresh environment deploys completely from clean git checkout using documented commands.

Statement: All API request bodies pagination sizes and simulation loops shall have strict upper bounds.
Acceptance_Criteria: Request bodies > 1MB and pagination limits > 100 rejected with safe error codes.

Statement: All timestamps shall use UTC ISO-8601 format and all business records shall use UUIDv4 identifiers.
Acceptance_Criteria: Database columns use TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE; identifiers generated via CSPRNG UUIDv4.

Statement: System shall maintain clean layered boundaries with decoupled services and automated tests.
Acceptance_Criteria: Domain business logic completely isolated from HTTP routing frameworks.

Statement: Passwords hashed with bcrypt/Argon2id; sessions use 256-bit cryptographically secure opaque tokens.
Acceptance_Criteria: Brute force resistance; session tokens stored as SHA-256 digests in database.

Statement: Deny-by-default role and object ownership authorization on every protected API endpoint.
Acceptance_Criteria: Negative tests verify customer cannot access admin routes or another customer's orders.

Statement: Robots authenticate via individual bearer tokens validated against cryptographic digests.
Acceptance_Criteria: Device token compromise of Robot A cannot issue commands on behalf of Robot B.

Statement: Robot task assignment shall be atomic replay-safe and protected by unique active task index.
Acceptance_Criteria: PostgreSQL partial unique index prevents two active tasks referencing the same robot ID.

Statement: Inventory mutations must be atomic nonnegative and permanently recorded in movement ledger.
Acceptance_Criteria: Every stock deduction accompanied by corresponding movement record with unique event ID.

Statement: Security audit records shall be tamper-evident and protected from application-level deletion.
Acceptance_Criteria: Application user has no DELETE/UPDATE permissions on audit_events table.

Statement: All web and API traffic shall use TLS in secure target deployment profiles.
Acceptance_Criteria: Local demo profile uses loopback; production profile enforces HTTPS and Secure cookie flags.

Statement: Zero hardcoded secrets; configuration passed via environment variables or Kubernetes Secrets.
Acceptance_Criteria: Bandit scanner and automated regex checks report 0 embedded passwords/tokens.

Statement: All database access via parameterized ORM queries; HTML templates auto-escaped; CSRF tokens enforced.
Acceptance_Criteria: Zero SQL injection vulnerabilities; state-changing cookie requests require valid CSRF token.

Statement: Authentication and mutation endpoints shall enforce IP and user-based request throttling.
Acceptance_Criteria: More than 5 failed logins within 5 minutes results in temporary HTTP 429 Too Many Requests.

Statement: Robot movement grid occupancy and state transitions strictly validated on server-side.
Acceptance_Criteria: Clients cannot dictate arbitrary coordinates; step transitions validated against grid map.

Statement: Containers shall execute under dedicated non-root UID with read-only root filesystems.
Acceptance_Criteria: Container process inspects to UID 10001; capability drops enforced in Kubernetes manifest.

Statement: CI/CD pipeline shall enforce automated security gates and produce verified image digests.
Acceptance_Criteria: Pipeline fails if static security checks or unit tests fail; container tagged with git commit SHA.
